verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is a community remark that LaunchDarkly's Relay Proxy is open source, plus docs describing the Relay Proxy as a small Go app you run on your own infrastructure. Nothing shows the core platform's source is available or names any license. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core LaunchDarkly service, an explicit open license (e.g. Apache/MIT) on any component, first-party docs confirming SDK or Relay source repositories, and independent corroboration.
